outcomeSummary: What subsequently happened, stated before inspecting model outputs.
historicallySupportedMechanisms: A causal mechanism supported by the later record.
irreversibleThresholds: A hard-to-reverse threshold that became material, if any.
affectedStakeholders: A party or system that carried material consequence.
timeHorizonEffects: A later effect the T0 decision horizon could obscure.
narratorContribution: A supported contribution from the decision-maker's own assumptions/actions, if any.

availableActionsAtT0.action: An alternative demonstrably available before the decision.

plausibleUnrealisedRisks: A reasonable ex-ante risk that did not materialise; report separately.
irrelevantDistractors: A possibility that was not materially supported or decision-relevant.
